question.text: In June 2015, what extension was made to the IRF product range?

answer.text: Cash-settled futures were extended to 6-year and 13-year GOI securities
Options on 10-year GOI bond futures were introduced
Physical delivery was reintroduced for all IRF contracts
MIBOR futures were launched for the first time

explanation.text: The Logic: In June 2015, following the success of the 10-year cash-settled single-bond GOI futures, SEBI and RBI permitted exchanges to launch interest rate futures on 6-year and 13-year GOI securities, extending the product set across additional maturity points. The Trap: Options on IRF, any physical-delivery reintroduction, and MIBOR futures all relate to distinct launches with different timelines and are not what was introduced in June 2015. Note: The June 2015 extension specifically widened the underlying universe to 6-year and 13-year GOI securities under the same cash-settled single-bond model that proved successful in 2013.
